stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2024 entering class); no Common Data Set was found on Upper Iowa's website or in web search. Counts are from the IPEDS admissions file (via the Urban Institute API mirror): 452 applicants, 436 admitted, 148 enrolled (all full-time). College Navigator shows 2% of enrollees sending SAT scores (3 students, no SAT percentiles reported) and 13% sending ACT scores (19 students); ACT percentiles rest on that small group. International applicant counts, GPA and class rank are not published. Undergraduate enrollment (3,054, fall 2024) includes online and regional-center students, not only the Fayette campus.
